title: Surreal Dreamscape Portrait
description: A surreal painting shows a glowing green-skinned woman with flowing cosmic hair in the foreground, gazing upward. Above her floats a large red female face with a clock embedded in her forehead, red tears streaming down, surrounded by red poppies against a misty Chinese mountain landscape with pagodas, traditional sailing ships on water, and small boats.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a luminous green-skinned woman with flowing teal and purple cosmic hair in the foreground looking upward, above her a giant floating red female face with a Roman numeral clock on her forehead and red liquid dripping from her eyes, large red poppies floating around, misty Chinese mountains with traditional pagodas and lanterns in the background, wooden junk ships and small boats sailing on calm water at dusk, ethereal glowing atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
